Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Banking hasn't changed much in decades. We're changing that. One product at a time.

Lunar is a Nordic challenger bank building the future of financial life with AI at the core. Our engineers, designers, and product people work on problems that actually matter. Making money simpler, smarter, and more rewarding for millions of people across the Nordics.

Fully licensed and founded in 2015, with offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Stockholm.

We move fast, we build with purpose, and we're just getting started.

As our new Data Scientist you'll join our team based in Aarhus, reporting to Eugene, our Senior Engineering Manager, working to bring data and machine learning into how we prevent fraud, manage risk, and grow the business.

What will you do?


Design, build, and deploy machine learning and statistical models across fraud detection, transaction monitoring, loan risk assessment, customer risk scoring, and sales and lead generation
Build and operate experimentation and evaluation frameworks — using tools like MLflow and Metaflow — with strong test sets and benchmarks across projects
Dive into data analysis and feature engineering to keep pushing model performance further
Partner closely with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to define requirements and turn insight into decisions
Document models, methodologies, and results clearly, and bring the latest ML and GenAI advances into how Lunar builds


What are we looking for in you?


Experience developing and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
Proficiency in Python and relevant ML libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
Experience with cloud-based ML platforms such as AWS SageMaker or Kubeflow
Solid grounding in machine learning, statistical modeling, and data analysis techniques — experience in financial services or another regulated industry is a plus
Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business insight


Benefits and perks


4 days in the office. We're a team that builds together, thinks together, and moves together. Showing up is part of how we work.
State of the art equipment. The newest computer, monitor, mouse, and keyboard. We want you to do your best work without anything slowing you down.
Pension, health insurance, and enhanced parental leave. From your financial future to your family moments. We've got you covered.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Vacature Data Scientist




Als Data Scientist zorg je ervoor dat wij de juiste in- en verkoop beslissingen nemen voor onze energieproducten om zo onze posities te optimaliseren. Dat betekent dat je een passie hebt voor het werken met complexe gegevens en data. Wil jij duurzame impact maken op financieel gebied? We komen graag met je in contact.




Dit ga je doen

Je komt te werken op de afdeling Trading. Deze afdeling stuurt assets als wind- & zonparken en grootschalige batterijopslag aan, maar maakt ook strategische beslissingen om de aansturing op een zo gunstig mogelijk moment te doen tegen een zo laag mogelijk risico.

Title: Data Scientist - Strategic Analytics Team
Description:
Our Story

Unum Technology Centre in Carlow serves as a strategic software development and IT services centre supporting Unum, a leading provider of income protection in the US. Our team of IT professionals build solutions and critical business applications to digitally transform the way we do business.

This position for an experienced data scientist who is excited to transform data into actionable insights and impactful solutions which drive business results. The role requires significant technical expertise in the fields of computer programming, applied statistics and data manipulation; and relies on increasing business knowledge. While some review by a manager is expected, this individual will take initiative in identifying and executing data science approaches to support business priorities.

The Role


Design and execute analytical solutions using optimization, simulation, data mining and other statistical methods with a focus on delivering actionable business value.
Integrate large volume of data from different sources (including Snowflake, DB2, SQL Server, Web API and Teradata) to create data assets for ad-hoc analyses and larger studies.
Apply validation, aggregation, and reconciliation techniques to create rich modeling-ready data framework.
Construct and tune predictive models to explain and understand observed events, forecast expected behavior, or identify risk through scoring or clustering.
Efficiently interpret results and communicate findings and potential value to influence manager and leadership decision making.
Support integration of solutions within existing business processes using automation techniques.
Understand theory and application of current and emerging statistical methods and tools.
Provides support, training and/or mentorship to lower level Data Science peers.
Perform other related duties as assigned


What You Offer


Bachelor’s degree in quantitative field is required, Master’s is preferred
4 plus years of professional experience or equivalent relevant work experience preferred
Core Data Science Capabilities: Deep expertise in at least two of the following skillsets preferred; and competency in the other:
Programming – Experience in programming languages, such as Python and R, to develop programs for manipulating large and complex datasets data analysis and implementing algorithms.
Data Visualization: Expertise on at least one visualization tool with working knowledge of others and expertise in static data visualization. Understanding of dynamic data visualization.
Statistics & Statistical modeling: Expertise using statistical inference and regression. Solid understanding of machine learning algorithms. Solid understanding of feature selection and extraction. Conducts end-to-end machine learning tasks from problem synthesis to model deployment.
Data Extraction, Transformation, and Loading: Preferred skills include: Expertise in writing complex SQL queries that join multiple tables/databases. Independently explore databases/tables to identify best data sources to solve business problems. Demonstrates ability to troubleshoot complex SQL queries with little guidance.
Core business capabilities: Demonstrated communication skills, experience in financial services, leadership experience working with senior management and executive leadership, and attention to detail while effectively and independently prioritizing work and managing multiple projects simultaneously.
Leadership Capabilities: Demonstrated ability to coach or mentor team members, ability to commit quickly and positively to change. Viewed as a promoter of change management and leads proof of concept work and prototyping when necessary
Preferred characteristics: Entrepreneurial self-starter, a thorough, results-oriented problem-solver, and a lifelong learner with voracious curiosity who effectively works as part of a diverse team.

Our size and successful history in Carlow means we can offer you exceptional development and progression, supported by continual learning programs, IT Certifications & third level tuition reimbursement. Our attractive range of benefits and reward initiatives includes competitive compensation, 25 days annual leave, paid health insurance, pension scheme, annual performance-based bonus, paid maternity/paternity/adoptive leave, reward programs, and an opportunity to engage with charity and community activities.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join one of our Telia Play teams, Content Voyage.

I’m Sara Hedenström, Head of Tech Content Voyage, and I’m searching for someone ready to grow with us. We’re a supportive, forward-thinking team focused on our mission to make entertainment deeply personal and intuitive. We are looking for a skilled Data Scientist to be the strategic brain behind our personalization features. In this role, you will act as the vital bridge between billions of behavioral signals and the intelligent features our viewers love. If you are passionate about training advanced machine learning models and want to see your algorithms directly shape what millions of people watch and discover, this is the role for you.

What you’ll do:

Build and scale deep learning models (ML Engineering & Data Science).


Build deep learning models: You will develop, optimize, and productionize our deep learning models using TensorFlow and Keras on GCP.
Orchestrate MLOps: Own end-to-end ML lifecycles using Vertex AI Pipelines and DVC, automating deployments with GitHub Actions and managing infrastructure via Terraform.
Drive experimentation: Design and execute rigorous A/B tests to measure the real-world impact of your models on user engagement and recommendation quality.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with Data Engineers, Product Managers, Backend, and Client teams to design ML features and ensure they are successfully delivered to users.
Model validation & analytics: Dive deep into the data using Python (Pandas, Polars) and SQL to understand model behavior, identify biases, and continuously improve prediction accuracy.
Shape our AI future: Bring a deep curiosity for modern ML techniques to help scale our infrastructure and build the next generation of adaptive, intelligent discovery features.


What will help you thrive in this role:

You are a strong communicator with the ability to explore and learn as we go. We believe in high standards with a playful mindset.


You are an experienced Data Scientist with proven hands-on experience building, training, and deploying production ML models on GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage).
You have strong deep learning fundamentals and practical experience with TensorFlow/Keras, especially for recommendation systems, ranking, or retrieval tasks.
You are proficient in Python and SQL, comfortable with data processing libraries (Pandas, Polars), and understand how to optimize queries and data pipelines for performance.
You have strong ownership and care deeply about code quality, writing tests, documenting your work, and building systems that are reliable, maintainable, and easy for others to understand and extend.
You have a genuine passion for AI/ML and personalization. You are energized by seeing your algorithms directly change user behavior. You want your models to help millions of people spend less time browsing and more time enjoying the content they love.


Join us to shape smarter living for people, businesses, and the planet

At Telia, we’re a team of 15,000 colleagues across the Nordics and Baltics, passionate about technology and connectivity. As a Top Employer and Sustainability Leader, we drive change with large-scale, impactful projects while building a sustainable, inclusive world.

Here, you can grow your skills, lead meaningful projects, and thrive in a supportive, diverse environment. Whether you’re taking your first step or your next, Telia is a place to grow, belong, and make a real impact.

What We Offer

At Telia, we care about your well-being, growth, and sense of belonging:


Additional health insurance and pension plans
Workation: work from anywhere in the EU for up to 30 days per year
Extra vacation days based on tenure (up to 5 additional days)
Discounts on Telia services, including free home internet
Partner offers and discounts (SPA, cafes, events)
Telia Kids Club: summer camps for employees’ children
Company-supported sports activities (yoga, basketball, running)
Internal training, leadership programs and job shadowing to explore new roles


and more.

Monthly salary range for this position: 4,300-6,500 EUR gross + annual performance/sales bonuses. The final offer may vary depending on your skills and experience.

Ready to make better happen?

We look forward to receiving your application by September 21. Please note that we might close the position earlier if we find the right candidate, so don’t wait too long to apply!

If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our Talent Acquisition Partner. Background and reference checks will be part of the process.

Equal opportunities

At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where your uniqueness is our strength.

Join us and let’s make better happen - together

Olisiko työn haastettava ja kehitettävä taitojasi? Tulisiko sen tuottaa tunne, että olet tekemässä jotain merkittävää? Haluaisitko työskennellä työyhteisössä, jossa välittäminen näkyy jokapäiväisissä teoissa ja kohtaamisissa?




Mitä jos sanoisimme, että meillä työskennellessäsi nämä kaikki seikat yhdistyvät yhdeksi – sinun erinomaiseksi työntekijäkokemukseksesi.




🚀 Lyhyt kuvaus työstäsi Full Stack Data Scientistina

Kanssamme luot asiakkaillemme liiketoiminnallista arvoa ja konkreettista kilpailuetua auttamalla heitä tekemään parempia päätöksiä datan avulla.




Konsultoit, kehität ja viet eteenpäin innovaatioita, jotka auttavat yrityksiä ja yhteisöjä toimimaan fiksusti ja ketterästi. Teet monimutkaisesta yksinkertaista uusimmilla teknologioilla, tehokkaimmilla laskentatavoilla ja parhailla käytännöillä.




Teknologisesta näkökulmasta erilaiset tietovarastot, laskentaympäristöt ja datankäsittelytyökalut ovat osa arkeasi siinä missä pilvipalvelut (AWS, ja Azure ja GCP) sekä ohjelmointikielet ovat erottamaton osa työtäsi.




Vielä lisää konkretiaa

Olemme ylpeitä, kuinka jatkuva oppiminen on luonnollinen osa nitorilaisten päivittäistä asiakasprojektissa työskentelyä. Lue Data Scientistimme, Tuukka Stewenin oppimismatkasta.

Täältä pääset tutustumaan Finnairille toteuttamaamme operatiivisen toiminnan työkaluun.

Data Scientistimme ja projektissa mukana ollut tuleva työkaverisi Jukka kertoo kokemuksiansa projektista ja meillä työskentelystä täällä.

Miltä dataosaajamme työpäivä näyttää – käy vilkaisemassa Eeron tarina.




🤝 Dataliiketoimintamme on yksi kasvualueistamme




Meillä on kokemusta ja osaamista merkittävien toimeksiantojen toteuttamiseen. Asiakastyytyväisyytemme on huippuluokkaa ja kehitämme jatkuvasti toimintaamme.




Katseemme on myös vahvasti tulevassa. Kun tulet työkaveriksemme, uskomme, että se vie meitä taas askeleen eteenpäin – samalla kun katsomme sinulle uraasi ja kehittymistäsi tukevat toimeksiannot, joissa työskentelet yhdessä toisten nitorilaisten kanssa. Meillä saat toteuttaa näköistäsi työelämää yhteiseen tulevaisuuteemme vaikuttaen.




Tuleva data-asiantuntijoiden tiimisi on tiivis startup-henkinen ja uuden oppimista arvostava, jolta löytyy poikkeuksellisen korkeatasoista dataosaamista. Ja jos palaset loksahtavat kohdalleen, tätä joukkoa sinä täydennät juuri sellaisena kuin olet.




✅ Mitä sinä voisit tuoda mukanasi?




Tässä tehtävässä loistat, kun sinulla on ohjelmointikokemusta, kyky kehittää koodia modernein menetelmin sekä matemaattisen ajattelun mentaliteetti ja taito. Olet kiinnostunut tekoälystä ja koneoppimisesta. Koska ala menee eteenpäin vauhdilla, on tärkeää, että olet innostunut uuden omaksumisesta ja näet haasteet mahdollisuuksina.




Mitä enemmän sinulla on osaamista, se luonnollisesti tarjoaa enemmän mahdollisuuksia heti ensimetreistäsi lähtien. Emme kuitenkaan halua liian tarkkaan määrittää tässä kohtaa, millainen sinun tulisi olla. Palaset kun voivat loksahtaa kohdalleen niin monella tapaa.




🏆Mitä jos valitsisitkin meidät?

Me uskomme, että rekrytoinnissa ei ole kyse siitä, että yritys valitsee uuden työntekijän. Sinä lopulta teet valinnan. Ja me voimme sinua siinä auttaa.




Sinun kannattaa olla meihin yhteydessä, jos

haluat työskennellä mielekkäiden toimeksiantojen parissa relevantteja, uusia asioita oppien.
rinnallasi työskentelevät osaavat kollegat, erinomaiset kouluttautumismahdollisuudet sekä optimaaliset työolosuhteet ja -välineet ovat sinulle tärkeitä asioita.
koet, että yhteisöllisyys ja toisille hyvän tahtominen ovat työelämässä merkityksellisiä arvoja.
sinusta on ihan ok tehdä normityöaikaa ja huolehtia, että vapaat ja työt pysyvät balanssissa.
työskentelet mielelläsi pitkäaikaisissa asiakkuuksissa projektista toiseen poukkoilun sijaan.




Työskentelyäsi ja arkeasi tukevat meillä myös muuten hyvin monimuotoiset edut ja mahdollisuudet:




Voit esimerkiksi käyttää 10 % työajastasi ammatilliseen kehittymiseen.
Palkitsemme suorittamasi sertifikaatit bonuksin (500–2000 €/sertifikaatti).
Saat käyttöösi 7100 € työvälineiden hankkimiseen.
Sinulla on mahdollisuus palkalliseen lomaan heti meillä aloitettuasi.
Lisäksi meillä on kattavat henkilöstöedut ja innostavaa yhteistä ajanviettoa.




⭐ Haluaisitko jutella kanssamme tarkemmin, mitä me voisimme sinulle tarjota?

Liity nyt data-ammattilaistemme, koodareidemme, suunnittelijoidemme ja valmentajiemme joukkoon työskentelemään luovassa sekä byrokratiavapaassa työkulttuurissa.




Olisimme todella innostuneita kuulemaan sinusta lisää. Kerro, millaista askelta olet urallasi ottamassa, ja katsotaan, miten me voisimme sinua auttaa.




❓Onko mielessäsi kysymyksiä? Pohdituttaako jokin seikka?

Lähetä meille viesti niin People Partnerimme Ella Raskila (ella.raskila@nitor.com) vastaa kaikkiin kysymyksiisi ja auttaa sinua. Varmistetaan, että saat kaiken tarvitsemasi tiedon sinulle tärkeän päätöksen tekemiseksi.




👥 Me kuuntelemme sinua

Me haluamme tarjota työntekijöillemme parhaan mahdollisen työpaikan ja tukea sinun osaamisesi kehittymistä. Nitorilla juuri sinä, ainutlaatuiset taitosi ja henkilökohtaiset kiinnostuksen kohteesi määrittävät urasi suunnan.

Kiehtovat projektit, luontainen uteliaisuutemme ja kollegojesi tuki motivoivat sinua jatkuvassa oppimisessa. Osallistut mielenkiintoisiin koulutuksiin, tapahtumiin ja konferensseihin. Lisäksi voit käyttää osan työajastasi uuden oppimiseen, yhteisömme kehittämiseen sekä sinua inspiroiviin pro bono –projekteihin.

Meillä urapolkusi ei ole ennalta määrätty – päinvastoin, kannustamme sinua tutkimaan kiinnostuksen kohteitasi ilman turhaa hierarkiaa ja byrokratiaa. Nitorilla äänesi kuuluu.




🎯 Lyhyesti Nitorista – toivottavasti sinunkin tulevasta työpaikastasi

Jokainen nitorilainen on pragmaattinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen tiimipelaaja, joka ei tyydy oletuksiin. Meille ominaista ovat todella korkea ammattitaito ja ylpeys niin omasta kuin kollegoidemmekin työstä.

Yli 250 asiantuntijaamme toimivat Helsingissä, Tampereella ja Tukholmassa, yhdistäen monipuoliset osaamisensa merkityksellisten vaikutusten saavuttamiseksi. Olemme ylpeitä työntekijälähtöisestä kulttuuristamme ja aidosta sitoutumisestamme ihmistemme kasvuun – tunnustuksena tästä meidät on palkittu Great Place to Work -sertifikaatilla sekä valittu Suomen vetovoimaisimmaksi työnantajabrändiksi.




Visiomme on selkeä: olla alan halutuin työpaikka, jossa menestys syntyy työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden hyvinvoinnista ja tyytyväisyydestä. Jatkamme kasvuamme IT-alan asiakastyytyväisyyden suunnannäyttäjänä tuottaen erinomaista lisäarvoa asiakkaillemme (lue, miten ainutlaatuinen asiakaskokemus ruokkii kasvuamme).

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Jouw veld van expertise

Als Data Scientist vertaal je data en complexe klantvraagstukken naar slimme, robuuste AI-oplossingen die aantoonbare waarde leveren. Je werkt aan het volledige traject: van het verkennen van het vraagstuk en de data tot het ontwerpen, bouwen en betrouwbaar laten draaien van oplossingen in productie. Je combineert data science, AI en cloudtechnologie.




Wat jij kunt doen als expert

Je brengt samen met de klant het businessvraagstuk, de beschikbare data en de technische omgeving in kaart. Vervolgens vertaal je deze naar een passende aanpak en bouw je de oplossing op moderne data- en AI-platformen zoals Databricks.




Je ontwikkelt of integreert data- en AI-componenten en bouwt de workflows en omgevingen die nodig zijn om deze veilig en schaalbaar te gebruiken. Dat varieert van machine-learningcomponenten tot GenAI-toepassingen met LLM’s en RAG.




Waar je op kunt bouwen

Een vast contract vanaf dag één.
Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid tot hybride werken.
Een open cultuur waarin kennisdeling, innovatie en samenwerking centraal staan.
Persoonlijke begeleiding via je Employee Success Manager.
Benieuwd naar wat we jou nog meer beloven? Klik hier.




Welke bouwstenen neem je mee

Je bent in het bezit van een relevant HBO-bachelor diploma.
Minimaal 3-4 jaar werkervaring
Je hebt ruime ervaring met Python en cloudplatformen als Microsoft Azure en AWS.
Begrijpt wat er nodig is om AI-oplossingen succesvol naar productie te brengen.
Je beschikt over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal goed in woord en geschrift.
Je bent praktisch ingesteld, neemt initiatief en steekt graag samen met je collega’s de handen uit de mouwen.

Title: Applied Machine Learning Lead
Description:
Position Overview

As our Applied Machine Learning Lead, you will play a key role in turning data into measurable business value. You will lead the identification, prioritisation, and delivery of high-impact machine learning and advanced analytics initiatives that improve player experiences, drive commercial outcomes, and support data-driven decision making across the organisation.

This is a senior, hands-on position that combines machine learning expertise, product thinking, and business leadership. You will work closely with stakeholders across the business to define opportunities, shape the roadmap, run experiments, and deliver scalable, production-ready machine learning solutions. You will also help establish technical standards and best practices, ensuring solutions are robust, reusable, and aligned with business needs.

Success in this role is measured not only by the quality and performance of machine learning models, but by the tangible impact they create. You will be responsible for translating insights into action, driving adoption, evaluating outcomes, and helping build a high-performing data science capability that delivers lasting value to the business.

Key Responsibilities


Lead and perform advanced commercial and business-focused analyses to support strategic decision-making.
Design, build, deploy, and maintain production-grade statistical and machine learning models, applying software engineering best practices to improve maintainability, reliability, testing, observability, and speed from experimentation to production.
Own the end-to-end experimentation lifecycle, from hypothesis definition and experiment design through implementation, validation, analysis, interpretation, and iterative optimisation.
Ensure analytical recommendations and model outcomes are grounded in statistically sound methods and commercially meaningful results.
Review, validate, and challenge analytical work, experiments, and machine learning models to ensure technical correctness, robustness, scalability, and business relevance.
Own and manage the data science backlog and roadmap, prioritising work in collaboration with stakeholders
Translate complex business problems into well-scoped initiatives with clear objectives, success criteria, and measurable outcomes.
Provide technical leadership on modelling approaches, feature engineering, validation methods, experimentation design, deployment practices, and continuous improvement of machine learning solutions
Develop reusable machine learning capabilities, analytical workflows, and technical standards to improve quality, consistency, scalability, and efficiency across the Data Science function.
Establish and promote standards for model review, documentation, feature engineering, validation, testing, monitoring, and production readiness.
Drive continuous improvement of the machine learning platform and team practices, including MLOps, AI-assisted development, automation, engineering productivity, and modern ways of building and operating ML systems.
Support and ensure adherence to governance, lifecycle management, and relevant policies and processes.
Monitor model performance, data drift, and impact; ensure appropriate retraining and continuous improvement.
Lead and manage the Data Science team, including coaching, feedback, performance discussions, and day-to-day prioritisation.
Collaborate closely with product, developers, and commercial teams to deliver data-driven solutions end-to-end
Communicate insights, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Requirements


Extensive experience in applied data science, analytics, and machine learning.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Solid understanding of statistical modelling, predictive analytics, experimentation, hypothesis testing, causal reasoning, and model validation.

The opportunity

We are currently seeking highly motivated people for our Consulting practice, which is a leading provider of services to financial industry and large corporate clients of all industries. Being part of our AI & Data team, you will work with multi-disciplinary teams across the entire EMEIA region to support global clients.

Your Key Responsibilities

You will identify appropriate modeling techniques to answer the most critical business questions and use your analysis to infer well substantiated business insights in support of your clients’ decision making.

You will also resort to various data management and visualization techniques to provide insight into the data. Your portfolio of skills covers a wide range of advanced statistical and machine learning techniques for classification, prediction, recommendation, clustering, forecasting, as well as data management, data visualization, and optimization, applied in a commercial context. You will contribute to presentations of modeling results and project proposals.

Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a Bachelor or a Master’s degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Econometrics, Engineering, Operational Research, Computer Science, or other related field with strong quantitative focus.
2-7 years of working or related research experience (evidenced by PhD and/or relevant publications, awards, or completed project credentials) with preferably at least 2 years in a commercial/industrial context and particular focus on the following:
Data modeling and Management, integration and manipulation of large disparate datasets (i.e. structured, semi-structured or unstructured)
Predictive modeling and optimization
Strong skills in databases, statistical packages for data manipulation and in development of predictive and prescriptive models (i.e. R, Python, SAS, SPSS, SQL).
Experience in designing, building, testing and validating models using a large number of statistical and other quantitative techniques.

Software development experiences in Java and/or C/C++ as well as advanced databases.
Experience with Big Data/In Memory technologies, such as Hadoop (Hortonworks, Cloudera etc), SAP HANA, IBM BigInsights, Oracle Exalytics.
Experience with scalable big data based advanced analytics software, such as Apache Mahout or 0xdata H2O.

Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills in English for both technical and business audiences.
Strong analytical, problem solving and critical thinking skills.
Ability to work under tight timelines for multiple project deliveries.
Ability/flexibility to travel and work abroad for international projects.


What We Look For

What’s most important is that you’re dedicated to working with your colleagues as part of a high-performing team. You’ll need to demonstrate enthusiasm, high motivation and passion to develop fast in a multinational working environment. You’ll need to thrive in picking up new skills and talents as you go, so natural curiosity, a lot of questions and the confidence to speak up when you see something that could be improved are essential. If you’ve got the right combination of technical knowledge and communication skills, this role is for you.

Ability to Shape your Future with Confidence by:


Developing your professional growth:
You'll have unlimited access to educational platforms, EY Badges and EY Degrees, alongside support for certifications. Our pride lies in working at EY as one of the most recognized employers in Greece through our multiple awards received over the last 4 years (Top Employer, Great Place to Work and Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting).

Description:
About the Role

We’re seeking a driven Data Scientist to join our FP&A team - someone who’s eager to work directly with senior leadership and bring predictive modelling, experimentation, and applied AI into a team that already understands the business deeply. This is a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.




Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

In this role, you’ll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Commercial teams, Tech, and the Data Platform team. You’ll help move the organisation from “what happened” to “what will happen” - translating business questions into statistical or ML problems, building and validating models, and delivering outputs that plug into the day-to-day work. As you grow, you’ll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.




Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:

Build, validate, and explain predictive models (classification, regression, time-series forecasting, cohort and churn analysis) that connect directly to a business process.
Apply NLP and LLMs to accelerate analytical workflows and unlock new capabilities - prompting, fine-tuning, and deploying language models where they sharpen the answer to a commercial question.
Deliver model outputs in a consumable format, building and enhancing Power BI reports on our Microsoft Fabric data platform for management and internal stakeholders.
Design and analyse commercial experiments (A/B tests, hypothesis-driven investigations, causal inference) to test what works before scaling.
Assist with scenario analysis to help inform strategic decisions made at the leadership level.




What We Are Looking For In You:

1+ years of experience with data science, advanced analytics, or an analytics engineering role - ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or subscription business.
Strong Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost). Able to build, validate, and interpret classification and regression models.
Applied NLP and LLM experience. Comfortable prompting, training, and deploying language models to solve real problems.
Experience building predictive models that were actually used in production or by business stakeholders - not just academic exercises.
Structured problem-solving. Can take an open question and decompose it into a testable hypothesis or a well-scoped modelling problem.




Why Join Us?

Direct exposure to decision-making at the highest level and learn how business challenges are tackled at the top level.
Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.
Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.
A dynamic, supportive environment where critical thinking is encouraged and your voice matters.
Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.




Great to Have (But Not Required)

Deeper ML & AI intuition - e.g. cross-validation strategy, the bias-variance tradeoff, regularization, gradient-based optimization, model calibration, SHAP-based explainability, and RAG vs. fine-tuning for LLM work.
Exposure to Power BI, DAX, and/or Power Query.
Experience or interest in working on cross-functional projects involving Tech/Product, Operations, Sales and Marketing.
Working knowledge of SQL and comfort pulling data directly from a data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar).




What we do at OrderYOYO

OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.




Who we are at OrderYOYO

Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

Since you’ve landed on this page, you already know Hedvig is a mover and shaker in insurtech, and think you might have what it takes to join us. We’ve been working hard since the very beginning to change an industry that is hard to love – to something at least likable. At Hedvig, we believe the only way to do so is to work with great people.




What about the role?

We are now looking for a Data Scientist to join our ambitious team at Hedvig, to solve complex business problems across the Hedvig using the latest advancements in AI and Machine Learning. The role involves high-impact work designing and developing ML models and agentic AI solutions for fair pricing, reserving, and lifetime value and more.




We believe, and know from experience, that we can accelerate faster by owning the entire pipeline from raw data to deployed model, reaping the benefits from developing with AI. Working closely with experienced backend developers, ML engineers, data analysts, and various business teams, you will have the opportunity to shape the data, tools, and innovative solutions that fuel our growth. This offers an inspiring freedom in what you will be able to create.




In the role you will:




Be a driving force in the development of our proprietary, next generation pricing platform powered by agentic AI development
Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and agentic AI systems to solve challenges across the business, including:
Engineering dynamic risk models to deliver highly personalized and competitive premium structures that balance fairness with sustainable profitability
Performing and developing the end-to-end reserving process, blending actuarial analysis with the continuous automation of our workflows
Driving sales growth by developing and deploying Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) models to optimize our marketing strategies
Drive machine learning and AI projects from project definition and raw data to deployed model and tracking of performance, with full end-to-end ownership
Evangelize the power of data and AI by promoting your work to the team, stakeholders and Hedvig as a whole
Be a driving force by always being on the lookout for new trends within AI, and Insurtech




What about you?

The Foundation: You hold a Master’s. in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
Proven Impact: Relevant professional experience delivering ML models end-to-end in production, preferably in Fintech or Insurtech. Direct exposure to insurance pricing, actuarial frameworks, or credit risk modeling is a significant advantage that will distinguish your profile.
The Generative Frontier: You are hands-on or experimenting with the modern AI stack, including LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases, and fine-tuning
Agentic Thinking: You have a thirst for building and deploying agentic AI systems capable of complex, multi-step decision-making and tool-use within a business context
From Foundations to Frontiers: You possess a deep algorithmic understanding of machine learning models - from classical GLMs and GBMs to Transformers. You use this knowledge to independently select, develop, interpret, and evaluate the most appropriate solutions for complex problems.
Full-Stack Mindset: You are highly proficient in Python and standard DS libraries, with strong working knowledge of SQL and experience preparing, transforming and working with large datasets for ML.
Production-Ready: Experience deploying and operating ML solutions in a cloud environment (GCP, AWS, or Azure), including model versioning, monitoring, CI/CD and best MLOps practices.
The AI Advocate: You thrive in collaborations, translating problems into rigorous quantifiable solutions, and love evangelizing ML models and agentic AI
Business impact: You independently validate models and interpret their performance to make decisions maximising the business impact of them.




Those are not hard requirements! If you have a different profile but you see that you have relevant skills and you think you can do a remarkable job, apply and share with us your motivation on why we should meet you.

We’ve been working hard since the very beginning to change an industry that is hard to love – to something at least likable. At Hedvig, we believe the only way to do so is to work with great people.


What about the role?

We are now looking for a Data Scientist to join our ambitious team at Hedvig, to solve complex business problems across the Hedvig using the latest advancements in AI and Machine Learning. The role involves high-impact work designing and developing ML models and agentic AI solutions for fair pricing, reserving, and lifetime value and more.


We believe, and know from experience, that we can accelerate faster by owning the entire pipeline from raw data to deployed model, reaping the benefits from developing with AI. Working closely with experienced backend developers, ML engineers, data analysts, and various business teams, you will have the opportunity to shape the data, tools, and innovative solutions that fuel our growth. This offers an inspiring freedom in what you will be able to create.


In the role you will:


  • Be a driving force in the development of our proprietary, next generation pricing platform powered by agentic AI development
  • Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and agentic AI systems to solve challenges across the business, including:
  • Engineering dynamic risk models to deliver highly personalized and competitive premium structures that balance fairness with sustainable profitability
  • Performing and developing the end-to-end reserving process, blending actuarial analysis with the continuous automation of our workflows
  • Driving sales growth by developing and deploying Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) models to optimize our marketing strategies
  • Drive machine learning and AI projects from project definition and raw data to deployed model and tracking of performance, with full end-to-end ownership
  • Evangelize the power of data and AI by promoting your work to the team, stakeholders and Hedvig as a whole
  • Be a driving force by always being on the lookout for new trends within AI, and Insurtech


What about you?

  • The Foundation: You hold a Master’s. in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
  • Proven Impact: Relevant professional experience delivering ML models end-to-end in production, preferably in Fintech or Insurtech. Direct exposure to insurance pricing, actuarial frameworks, or credit risk modeling is a significant advantage that will distinguish your profile.
  • The Generative Frontier: You are hands-on or experimenting with the modern AI stack, including LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases, and fine-tuning
  • Agentic Thinking: You have a thirst for building and deploying agentic AI systems capable of complex, multi-step decision-making and tool-use within a business context
  • From Foundations to Frontiers: You possess a deep algorithmic understanding of machine learning models - from classical GLMs and GBMs to Transformers. You use this knowledge to independently select, develop, interpret, and evaluate the most appropriate solutions for complex problems.
  • Full-Stack Mindset: You are highly proficient in Python and standard DS libraries, with strong working knowledge of SQL and experience preparing, transforming and working with large datasets for ML.
  • Production-Ready: Experience deploying and operating ML solutions in a cloud environment (GCP, AWS, or Azure), including model versioning, monitoring, CI/CD and best MLOps practices.
  • The AI Advocate: You thrive in collaborations, translating problems into rigorous quantifiable solutions, and love evangelizing ML models and agentic AI
  • Business impact: You independently validate models and interpret their performance to make decisions maximising the business impact of them.


Those are not hard requirements! If you have a different profile but you see that you have relevant skills and you think you can do a remarkable job, apply and share with us your motivation on why we should meet you.


What about us?

As part of the Hedvig team, you quickly notice that "general truths" are not accepted without being questioned. We're an enthusiastic group of people who love to challenge each other to find the best way forward. We don't care who says something; we care about what's being said. We put a lot of effort into building a trusting culture where freedom, collective thinking, and individual ownership have center stage. We're not perfect – far from it – but we talk about and learn from our mistakes and imperfections to improve continuously. And we have a lot of fun along the way! As individuals, as a team, and as a company.


Come join the Hedvig team, including all of our very loved office pups, in newly renovated offices in central Stockholm.

Title: Data scientist (m/f) - A1
HTML:
Informations générales

  • Statut: Employé de l'État

  • Groupe d'indemnité: A1

  • Nombre de postes vacants: 1

  • Nationalité: Être ressortissant UE

  • Catégorie de métiers: Technologie de l'information et de la communication

Qui recrute ?

L’Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD) recherche un Data Scientist pour son Département Données, Analyses, et IA. Le candidat contribuera à renforcer la détection des risques liés aux réglementations fiscales, en développant des solutions innovantes pour automatiser la conformité, optimiser les processus fiscaux et soutenir la prise de décision stratégique.

Missions

  • Analyser des données administratives complexes (non conçues pour l’analyse) pour en extraire des insights actionnables;

  • Participer au développement et maintenance de pipelines de données pour valoriser des données internes et externes;

  • Concevoir et maintenir des applications analytiques (ex : Dataiku, streamlit , QLIK) pour cibler les fraudes ou soutenir les décisions;

  • Collaborer avec les équipes métiers pour traduire leurs besoins en solutions data (ex : modèles de segmentation, outils de compliance);

  • Innover avec de nouvelles technologies (intelligence artificielle) tout en garantissant leur usage approprié.

Profil

Compétences techniques

  • Savoir développer des applications Data/IA en Python : code modulaire, testable, et déployable en production (bonnes pratiques DevOps);

  • Expérience en traitement de données avec python, SQL / VQL (virtualisation des données) pour nettoyer, lier et analyser des datasets structurés et non structurés;

  • Expérience en analyse de séries temporelles, en optimisation mathématique, et des modèles de simulation;

  • Savoir utiliser des techniques statistiques, Machine Learning, et IA générative pour découvrir des relations cachées;

  • Expérience démontrée en traduction de problèmes métiers (ex : fraude, compliance) en solutions data/IA;

  • Savoir définir des MVPs (Minimum Viable Product) prioriser les livrables et travailler avec une approche « build – measure - learn »;

  • Savoir expliquer des concepts techniques à des non-experts (ex : présenter un modèle de détection de fraude à des agents fiscaux);

  • Savoir choisir la bonne technologie pour communiquer et visualiser des résultats.

Compétences comportementales

  • Rigueur, autonomie, pédagogie et collaboration multidisciplinaire;

  • Adaptabilité aux évolutions réglementaires et technologiques;

  • Motivation et capacité d’apprentissage rapide pour maîtriser les spécificités fiscales internationales.

Atouts

  • Une exposition à un environnement fiscal ou réglementé (finance, assurance, administration publique) est un atout clé pour ce rôle;

  • Connaissance des enjeux de transparence fiscale internationale et des outils associés;

  • Maitrise courante de l’anglais.

Conditions d’admission

Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut de l'employé de l'État.

Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission pour devenir employé de l'État.

Diplômes

Vous êtes titulaire d’un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d’enseignement supérieur reconnu par l’État du siège de l’établissement et sanctionnant l’accomplissement avec succès d’un master en informatique, mathématiques, data science ou de son équivalent.

Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications.

Expérience

Vous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans dans le domaine.

Langues

Vous répondez aux exigences des connaissances de 3 langues administratives pour le groupe d'indemnité A1. Une dispense de deux des trois langues administratives peut être accordée sous certaines conditions.

Nationalité

Vous êtes ressortissant d’un État membre de l’Union européenne.

Documents à fournir

Lettre de motivation, copie du diplôme, CV



  • Pour ce poste, vous devez obligatoirement postuler en ligne via MyGuichet, les candidatures via courriel ou via courrier postal n’étant pas acceptées. Les documents sont à introduire via MyGuichet en format pdf (taille maximale 20 Mo).

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Client

A prominent global online gambling and entertainment enterprise focused on delivering secure, compliant, and data-driven experiences for its international customer base.

Join a great company, not merely an individual project

Project overview

Focused on enhancing customer safety and regulatory compliance, this project involves building, evaluating, and refining predictive risk-scoring models specifically for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Safer Gambling (SG) risk mitigation.

Position overview

We are seeking an experienced Data Scientist to take ownership of customer risk-scoring models and exploratory risk analysis. In this role, you will analyze complex behavioral data, conduct deep-dive investigations, and construct statistical models to protect both the business and its users.

Responsibilities
Design, evaluate, and iteratively refine predictive models targeting AML and Safer Gambling risk indicators.


Conduct exploratory data analysis and targeted investigations to identify behavioral anomalies and emerging risk patterns.
Partner with compliance and operational risk teams to translate risk domain insights into practical model features.
Clearly communicate analytical methodologies, model evaluation results, and strategic insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Requirements
5+ years of professional experience in a Data Scientist role.


Strong technical proficiency in Python and SQL for complex data extraction, feature engineering, and statistical modeling.
Practical expertise in building and evaluating standard statistical and machine learning models (e.g., XGBoost, Linear/Logistic Regression).
Strong analytical problem-solving skills with a background in model evaluation metrics and data-driven investigations.
Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex analytical concepts clearly.
Nice to have
Prior experience in online gaming.


Domain familiarity with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations or Responsible/Safer Gambling frameworks.
Basic conceptual understanding of model deployment pipelines (hands-on engineering deployment expertise is not required).

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
As Senior Data Scientist for Engineering Systems you will work independently alongside sharp, generous, and pragmatic engineers from Server Query, Atlas Clusters, and Release Quality, among other teams. Together, we tackle problems spanning resource scaling across the Atlas fleet, safe feature rollout to MongoDB clusters, automated incident response and query engine performance. Join the Platform Data Science team and help us research, prototype and ship machine learning features for MongoDB’s core server, query engine and Atlas, our database-as-a-service cloud offering.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin or Cork for our hybrid working model.

What You'll Do


Partner with Server Query, Atlas Clusters, Release Quality and other engineers to embed algorithmic rigor and optimization into resource scaling, release-safety and monitoring systems across the fleet and inside query engine
Deliver production-ready, thoroughly tested statistical and ML algorithms with well-identified limitations that deliver measurable business impact, not just an impressive-sounding methodology
Own the full feedback loop: instrument model architecture with the metrics needed to track performance and create dashboards in collaboration with our stellar analytics team, collect feedback from users and metrics to diagnose issues or opportunities, and iterate accordingly
Deliver thoughtful, kind code reviews to your peers and act as a core contributor to internal packages, tooling, and team processes that increase developer productivity


Measures of Success


In 3 months, you’re familiar with our workflow, have an elementary understanding of our product and what teams we work with. You have delivered small-to-medium improvements to our project portfolio
In 6 months, you’ve delivered one feature you researched and prototyped from scratch and demonstrated its impact on business metrics of your choice
In 12 months, you've established a track record of shipping ML-driven improvements to fleet stability, efficiency, or operational automation; deepened working relationships with two or more partner engineering teams; and become a go-to resource for statistical or engineering rigor across the team


Skills & Attributes


5+ years of hands-on machine learning model development, working directly with technical stakeholders
Expertise and track of record working autonomously across the entire machine learning development lifecycle, including prototyping, simulation, tuning and iterating on products in deployment environments with and without dedicated engineering help
Embraces an object-oriented approach to designing scalable and readable Python codebase, and has experience working with engineers on architecture design of machine learning systems
Our codebase is primarily in Python and we use AI for developer productivity - but we expect all ICs to review, understand, and be able to redesign any code that ships regardless of whether a human or an AI wrote the first draft
Takes ownership of team culture: models psychological safety, and - in whatever way suits their style, whether that's a quiet word or a vocal challenge - encourages others to speak up and calls out when the environment isn't living up to it
Effective at communicating technical ML concepts to non-ML-experts audiences; e.g. able to translate efficacy measurements of ML models and products into tangible business impact metrics
Master's degree or equivalent experience in a quantitative/computational discipline (computer science, applied mathematics, statistics, physics, operations research, etc.)


About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

Title: Data Scientist – Cloud Data Technologies
Description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

The Cloud Data Technologies (CDT) team at eBay is responsible for eBay’s data infrastructure, including the experimentation platform and the end-to-end data lifecycle, from onsite data through to analytics use cases.

We are seeking a Data Scientist to help improve the speed and quality of decision-making by applying advanced data science methods and turning complex data into actionable insights. You will have the chance to work on projects involving machine learning-based bot traffic detection and customer profile development. This includes improving A/B testing methods such as interleaving tests, sequential testing, and Bayesian methods.

What you will accomplish


Contribute to complex data science projects, from analysis through model development and performance evaluation.
Develop and implement advanced statistical models and machine learning algorithms to address business and data challenges.
Support experimentation and causal inference initiatives, including A/B and multivariate testing and improvements to testing methodologies.
Use advanced SQL to work with large-scale datasets and optimize big data queries.
Collaborate with multi-functional teams to define requirements and develop data solutions that support effective decision-making.
Contribute to machine learning use cases such as bot traffic detection and customer profile development.
Evaluate relevant developments in data science and identify new technologies or methodologies that could improve existing approaches.



What you will bring


5+ years of relevant experience with a master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science or another quantitative field.
Experience building statistical or machine learning models and evaluating model performance.
Proficiency in Python or R and relevant machine learning libraries, such as scikit-learn or GBM.
Advanced SQL skills, including experience optimizing queries for large-scale data.
Experience working with Hadoop and Spark in cloud environments.
Strong problem-solving skills and experience deploying machine learning models in production environments.
Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings to non-technical audiences.



Additional Details

Title: Data Science Engineer (f/m/d) - ID:2699811
Description:
WHAT WE BUILD




Most companies find out about supplier insolvencies, cyber attacks, factory fires or floods that affect their supply chain when it's already a crisis. Prewave exists to change that. We're an AI-native company giving BMW Group, Hilti and Lufthansa real-time visibility into supply chain risks before they become headlines.




We're looking for a Data Science Engineer who takes ownership of turning vast, complex data into actionable intelligence from day one. Someone who uses AI as a default part of how they work - and knows when to trust their own judgment.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN




Decode the data – Leverage natural language processing (NLP) to extract meaning from diverse datasets.
Think like a scientist – Formulate hypotheses, uncover patterns, and pinpoint optimization opportunities.
Build smarter AI – Develop, fine-tune, and deploy machine learning models using Torch and TensorFlow.
Bridge research & reality – Transform cutting-edge algorithms into production-ready solutions.

Title: Data Scientist - vær med til at udvikle prognoser, der holder elnettet i balance
Place: Fredericia, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Data Scientist - vær med til at udvikle prognoser, der holder elnettet i balance

Forestil dig, at din machine learning-model er en del af grundlaget for de beslutninger, der træffes i kontrolcenteret for at sikre strøm til millioner af danskere. I Energinet udvikler vi prognoser og datadrevne beslutningsværktøjer, som bruges til den daglige balancering og drift af det danske elnet. Efterhånden som stadig mere vedvarende energi kobles på systemet, stiger behovet for præcise prognoser, avancerede modeller og intelligent automatisering.

Til vores data science-team søger vi en Data Scientist, der vil være med til at udvikle næste generation af prognoser og machine learning-løsninger til et energisystem i hastig forandring.

Bliv en del af vores specialiserede data science forecasting-team

På kontoret i Fredericia bliver du en del af afdelingen Digitale Balanceringsprodukter, hvor vi arbejder med nogle af Energinets mest forretningskritiske digitale løsninger. Vi udvikler, vedligeholder og forbedrer prognosemodeller, der understøtter kontrolcenterets arbejde med at holde elnettet stabilt og effektivt. Vores løsninger anvendes operationelt hver dag og er et vigtigt input til beslutninger om balancering af elsystemet.

Vi er et tværfagligt team bestående af Software Engineers og Data Scientists, der arbejder tæt sammen om at omsætte store datamængder til robuste og driftssikre løsninger. Samtidig indgår vi i et større setup med andre digitale produktteams, hvor samarbejde og videndeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

"Hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde med reelle og komplekse data science-løsninger i en kontekst, hvor modellerne skaber reel værdi hver eneste dag. Vi kombinerer avanceret teknologi med en vigtig samfundsopgave og et solidt fagligt fællesskab,” fortæller Lene Lindstrøm Olsen, Senior Manager.

Du er med til at udvikle Energinets forecasting-løsninger

Du bliver en central del af arbejdet med at udvikle Energinets forecasting-løsninger, og du kommer bl.a. til at:


Udvikle og forbedre machine learning-modeller til prognoser og beslutningsstøtte
Arbejde med store mængder historiske data og realtidsdata
Omsætte komplekse forretningsbehov til robuste data science-løsninger
Sikre høj kvalitet og stabil drift af modeller i produktion
Samarbejde tæt med specialister, produktfolk og brugere i organisationen
Bidrage til den tekniske retning for teamets data science-løsninger



Samtidig bliver du en del af en spændende udvikling, hvor vi moderniserer vores platforme, udbygger vores arbejde med MLOps og udvikler næste generation af forecasting-løsninger, der skal understøtte fremtidens energisystem.

”Du bliver ikke blot en udførende specialist. Du får også mulighed for at bidrage til både de tekniske løsninger og teamets faglige udvikling,” pointer Lene.

Erfaring med data science og udvikling af modeller

Vi forventer, at du har en længerevarende uddannelse inden for matematik eller data science. Dertil har du flere års erfaring med data science og udvikling af modeller, der skaber værdi i praksis.

Derudover vægter vi positivt, at du har erfaring med:


Python, herunder Pandas og PySpark
Machine Learning og statistisk modellering
Udvikling og drift af modeller i produktionsmiljøer
Azure, Databricks og Delta Lake
Samarbejde på tværs af teknik og forretning



Du er nysgerrig på energisystemer, forecasting og komplekse operationelle problemstillinger, men du behøver ikke at kende energibranchen på forhånd.

Som person motiveres du af at løse komplekse problemer sammen med andre. Du er fagligt dygtig og deler gerne din viden, men du ved også, at de bedste løsninger skabes i fællesskab. Du trives med at tage initiativ og har lyst til at omsætte data science til konkrete løsninger.

Vil du være med til at udvikle fremtidens prognoser?

Så ser vi frem til at modtage dit motiverede CV senest 6. september. Sæt allerede nu et par forsigtige kryds i kalenderen. Vi forventer at holde 1. samtale online 16. september og


samtale i Fredericia 23. september.



Er du nysgerrig på din kommende leder, eller har du spørgsmål til jobbet og teamet? Se nærmere på LinkedIn eller ring til Lene Lindstrøm Olsen på tlf. 5363 6193.

Særlige forhold: Da Energinet løser samfundskritiske opgaver, udfører vi baggrundstjek forud for ansættelsen. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at dit baggrundstjek er foreneligt med ansættelse i Energinet. Baggrundstjekket gennemføres desuden én gang årligt.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer alle kvalificerede, uanset baggrund, til at søge jobbet. Vi arbejder aktivt og målrettet med mangfoldighed i Energinet og opfordrer dig derfor til at udelade billede, oplysninger om alder, civilstand og lignende, for at minimere ubevidste biases i processen. Du kan læse mere om vores mangfoldighedspolitik her.

Du bliver en del af Energinet Systemansvar, hvis kerneopgaver er at indpasse vedvarende energi, sikre lige adgang til nettene, udvikle markedsdesign, overvåge og balancere transmissionsnettet og at varetage forsyningssikkerheden i Danmark.

Glæd dig til at blive en del af en organisation med et meningsfuldt formål, hvor vi forsyner Danmark med el og gas, og omstiller energisystemet til grøn energi.

For at lykkes med den opgave, skal vi have dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere. Derfor har vi skabt rammer, hvor udvikling prioriteres, nye idéer bliver taget alvorligt, og der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv. Vi kalder det Energi til mere, og du kan blive endnu klogere på det her

Title: Data Scientist, 3D Point Cloud
Description:
Work in Supervisely

Data Scientist, 3D Point Cloud

We are building a top data science team focused on computer vision and are looking for exceptional people to work with us. You will enjoy an opportunity to train and apply state-of-the-art models to various real world tasks, design custom training and inference pipelines, integrate neural networks into Supervisely and share them with the entire ML community.

In addition, we are doing cutting-edge research in various directions, including labeling automation, AI-assisted tools to speed up data annotation, synthetic datasets, human-in-the-loop, active learning, GANs, and many more.

Most common modality to work will be 3d Point clouds (separate ones and episodes) and sensor fusion (LiDAR, camera, radar, etc).

Machine Learning

Remote

About Supervisely

You can think of Supervisely as an Operating System available via Web Browser to help you solve Computer Vision tasks. The idea is to unify all the relevant tools within a single Ecosystem of apps, tools, UI widgets and services that may be needed to make the AI development process as smooth and fast as possible.

More Concretely, Supervisely Includes The Following Functionality


Data labeling for images, videos, 3D point clouds and volumetric medical images (DICOM)
Data visualization and quality control
State-Of-The-Art Deep Learning models for segmentation, detection, classification and other tasks
Interactive tools for model performance analysis
Specialized Deep Learning models to speed up data labeling (aka AI-assisted labeling)
Synthetic data generation tools
Instruments to make it easier to collaborate for data scientists, data labelers, domain experts and software engineers

Creating Supervisely Apps, main areas include development of Data Pipelines for 3D modality and Machine Learning models infrastructure
Working with top github repositories with state-of-the-art models, train, test, deploy and integrate them into Supervisely
Coding mostly in Python, basic understanding of HTML and Vue.js is welcomed, but not required
Handling the entire model lifecycle: data preparation, training, inference, model debugging, comparison, deployment. Building special ML tools for work automation and publish them in our Ecosystem
Experiment with modern research, explore SOTA papers and conferences
Proactively solving technical challenges and fixing bugs
Contributing ideas and constructive feedback to our product development roadmap
Sharing your knowledge with community developers by creating tech videos, blog posts and promoting appropriate tech and engineering best practices in and outside of the team
Collaborating with Enterprise customers to help with integration and building customized data and model pipelines
Improving documentation, creating guides and tutorials for our developer portal


We Are Looking For


Industry experience in data science and machine learning (1+ years recommended)
Knowledge of major Python libraries like Pytorch, Tensorflow, Numpy, Pandas, requests, sklearn, OpenCV, Open3D
Solid understanding of modern developer tools: docker, git, github, vscode, venv
Good principles towards writing clean, simple and maintainable code
Good verbal and written communication skills in English
Leveraging our in-house data and model platform that allow you to perform experiments in a matter of days


You Will Get Extra Credits For


Participating and winning Kaggle competitions
Experience in 3d-NN frameworks like MMDetection3d
Experience in organizing dataset creation from scratch, experimentation with GANs or synthetic data
Experience in building client-server apps using FastApi, Flask, Uvicorn or others
Development of your own Python library / repository or participating and contributing in a popular one
Familiarity with any cloud systems (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
University degree in a technical subject (Computer science, Mathematics, or similar) or equivalent experience in the industry
Experience creating tutorials, videos or technical blog posts, publications
Experience in building your own startup or product

Play a direct role in shaping the future of building Computer Vision solutions

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

Are you a collaborative, analytical, and business-minded Data Scientist who enjoys optimizing complex enterprise systems? Our Deployment Technology team builds the next generation of enterprise tooling to make the migration, configuration, and adoption of Workday features as quick, seamless, and reliable as possible for our customers and implementation partners. We are a dynamic, supportive team that values innovation, continuous delivery, and high-quality data products. If you want to use advanced analytics to help thousands of global enterprises transition smoothly to Workday, we would love to connect with you.

About The Role
